scoring_justification: Recompute plasmon frequencies and FWHM from raw absorption spectra to compare against paper's reported values, not trusting agent's summary file.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold plasmon frequencies and FWHM for all clusters extracted from paper Figures 4, 5, 7, 9 and associated text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported values and approximate digitization from figures.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted from paper figures and text; approximate interpolation for missing points.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These numbers reflect the published results, ensuring the checker verifies the agent's reproduction matches the original claims.

schema.description: Each row gives the normalized absorption cross section per atom for a specific cluster and photon energy.

outputs.description: Raw simulated absorption spectra; the checker will verify structural plausibility (e.g., peak location near expected plasmon energies).

schema.description: Each row contains the plasmon resonance frequency and full width at half maximum for one cluster.

outputs.description: Extracted plasmon properties; the checker compares plasmon_freq_eV and FWHM_eV against published reference values with tolerances (±0.15 eV for frequency, ±0.2 eV for width).

output_contract.notes: The checker uses the plasmon_summary.csv as the primary scored artifact, comparing frequencies and widths to paper-reported values using a threshold-or-better policy. The absorption_spectra.csv is audited for structural consistency.

steps.description: Recompute plasmon frequency and FWHM from absorption_spectra.csv and compare to paper gold values.
